info.name: LOS & LMS Rejection Webhooks
info.description: Collection to test and simulate Rejection Webhooks between LOS (Personal Loan Platform) and LMS (Fintree LMS).

item.name: 1. Inbound: LMS Rejects Case -> LOS Rejection Webhook

body.raw:
{
  "lan": "{{lan}}",
  "status": "REJECTED",
  "stage": "LMS_REJECTED",
  "message": "Loan application rejected by LMS",
  "reject_reason": "Bank verification failed (NAME_MISMATCH) / Credit review rejected",
  "rejected_by": "credit_manager@fintree.com",
  "timestamp": "{{$isoTimestamp}}"
}

request.description: Fin-Le-LMS dispatches this outbound webhook to LOS when a loan case is rejected.

item.name: 2. Inbound: LMS Rejects Case -> LOS Rejection Webhook (Default Path)

body.raw:
{
  "lan": "{{lan}}",
  "status": "REJECTED",
  "stage": "LMS_REJECTED",
  "message": "Loan application rejected by LMS",
  "reject_reason": "Bank verification failed (NAME_MISMATCH) / Credit review rejected",
  "rejected_by": "credit_manager@fintree.com",
  "timestamp": "{{$isoTimestamp}}"
}

request.description: Fallback endpoint if lender code is omitted from path.

item.name: 3. Outbound: LOS Rejects Case -> LMS Webhook

body.raw:
{
  "lan": "{{lan}}",
  "status": "REJECTED",
  "stage": "LOS_REJECTED",
  "message": "Loan application rejected",
  "reject_reason": "Application did not meet lender criteria.",
  "timestamp": "{{$isoTimestamp}}"
}

request.description: Sent by LOS to LMS when LOS rejects an application.
